title: Space Operators
description:
Welcome to Mega Corporation Mining Industry!"Welcome to your new job as a Space Operator at Mega Corporation Mining Industry. We expect nothing but excellence from you given your application. Do not disappoint us".

You wake up from your long sleep in the hyperchamber. But how did you actually pass the interview? Anyway, you must prove your skills now to make your parents proud. 

Control your drone!In a world where resources are slim, you have to operate drones to win against other mega-companies in battles on various moons in order to harvest the resources from the moons. 

Enjoy the calm yet exciting atmosphere of this retro 2D turn-based pixel game and capture the moons for the Mega Corporation Mining Industry. 

Main features:These are the currently available features. We aim to add more throughout Early Access.

• 19 unique missions across various moons

• 6 endless minigames

• 9 different weapons of choice

Try out the free demo and wishlist Space Operators now!
description_short: This is an old-school tank shooter set in space. Conquer newly discovered moons for Mega Corporation Mining Industry to earn your paycheck and make your parents proud! Win battles with your drone by blowing up your rivals in this retro pixel art game.
